name: The Phantom Weapon & The Iron Poker
narrative: Delirious from severe hypothermia recovery, Kael hears a nihilistic voice whisper from the void: 'end Marcus life'. He experiences a violent psychic dissociation, reaching for an imagined weapon. But firearms do not exist in this post-scarcity world. His trembling hand grabs the cold iron hearth poker. He lunges at Marcus, but Marcus's 'Will to Live at All Costs' trait instantly triggers: Marcus sidesteps the clumsy swing, catches Kael's wrists, and pins him gently against the cedar wall until the phantom delusion shatters into reality.

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The iron poker clatters against the granite hearth; heavy panting in the warm hall as the violent phantom delusion is subdued by living fellowship.

new_decision.decision: Heard a destructive command from the void to end Marcus, lost consciousness, and grabbed the iron poker believing it was a gun.
new_decision.impact: Exposed the final psychological trap of nihilism: the desire to manufacture melodrama or bloodshed when stillness fails. Subdued without bloodshed.

new_decision.decision: Will to Live at All Costs triggered: Disarmed a delirious Kael, locked his arms, and forced him to drop the iron poker without inflicting harm.
new_decision.impact: Refused to die; defended his life and preserved the brotherhood.

new_decision.decision: Recognized Kael's acute paradoxical delirium from rewarming shock and administered crushed valerian root to calm the nervous system.
new_decision.impact: Medically stabilized severe post-hypothermic psychic episode.
